unsupported: The business began as a solo woodworking venture focused on preserving local history through functional pieces.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind tables, bookcases, bars, benches, and other furniture using a three-step collaborative process: clients select reclaimed materials, Hollingsworth develops a design, and the finished piece is delivered. All work is performed in-house, with each item handcrafted to the customer’s specifications.
The company serves residential clients and interior designers seeking distinctive, story-rich furnishings.
Past projects include an eight-foot barnwood bookcase with adjustable shelves, a rustic high-top bar for a home entertainment area, and an entryway bench crafted from reclaimed barn flooring.
